verdict.summary: The two hermetic guards are preserved as the first executable checks after checkout in the existing gating gui-mock-ipc job, which has no advisory registry entry, continue-on-error, if, or needs condition. Removing the standalone job therefore retains the guards' blocking behavior while avoiding a separate runner. The policy and advisory-registry references are updated consistently, and the registry test now protects the actual gating job name from accidental advisory declaration. No correctness, security, or test-validity defect is evident in the scoped change.
